title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for s ↦ X(ψ_s): derivative X(∂_sψ_s) and ∫_0^1 X(∂_sψ_s) ds = X(ψ_1) − X(ψ_0) (supplied step 8)
statement: Let m, q ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_q(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn univ q with M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ D^q(ℝ^{m+1}) and Ψ, Ψ′ : ℝ → D^q(ℝ^m) with Ψ(s)(x)(v) = ψ(cons(s,x))(fun i => ι(v i)) and Ψ′(s)(x)(v) = (fderiv ℝ ψ (cons(s,x)) e₀)(fun i => ι(v i)) for all s ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^m, v : Fin q → ℝ^m (cons, ι, e₀ as above). Then s ↦ X(Ψ′(s)) is continuous on ℝ; for every s ∈ ℝ the map t ↦ X(Ψ(t)) has derivative X(Ψ′(s)) at s; and ∫_0^1 X(Ψ′(s)) ds = X(Ψ(1)) − X(Ψ(0)).
lean_statement: ∀ (m q : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) q) (Ψ Ψ' : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ' s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = fderiv ℝ (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Continuous (fun s => X (Ψ' s)) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t => X (Ψ t)) (X (Ψ' s)) s) ∧ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (Ψ' s) = X (Ψ 1) - X (Ψ 0)
